story.body: You let Master Thwaite have his three heads, and you did not add a fourth. When a man asked Gillis his parish, you left the answer to Gillis, and it was Norwich. You told Thwaite you have heard no order that shuts the door. Sir John passed and was not spoken to. You walked home behind the household.

story.body: You dated the page the twenty-ninth of June 1595. You set down the thumb short of the notch, the cat on the Golding, and Brooke still up. You wrote that no order has shut the house. You did not start a speech.

story.body: You heard the sound, stayed in, and took the other end of the bar when she asked. You did not go toward the Hill. You let Gillis go up without making a speech of it. You told her the upstairs candle was yours. You sent Alse indoors. You said you would bar your own door.
